name: What steps are involved in the basement remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the basement remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement remodels follow a structured construction sequence starting with demolition, framing, and mechanical rough-ins. First, crews frame exterior perimeter walls, partition rooms, and frame around structural columns and low-hanging ductwork. Next, licensed trades install plumbing pipes, electrical wiring, and HVAC supply runs. Once city inspectors approve the rough-in work, insulation is installed, followed by drywall hanging, taping, and texturing. The final phase involves interior painting, trim carpentry, flooring installation, hanging doors, and setting plumbing fixtures and light switches.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves framing, rough-in plumbing and electrical, city inspections, insulation, drywall, painting, trim carpentry, and final fixture installations.
